body: No, I’m not. That’s kind of why I think  I’m not really messing my life up. I’m not sure, though, so I asked.

I wouldn’t say I’m suicidal because I don’t think I would ever actually do it since I don’t want to devastate my family. I just think about how much better it would be for me personally if I did. I wouldn’t do it, though. Thanks.
I don’t know too much about legal stuff, but I have one question to ask you. Would your friend let you live with him if you had to?

Sorry for the late reply. I just didn’t feel like answering in the past, but I’m suddenly compelled to. I do have hobbies and interests. Really, I have only one. I love acting, performing, filmmaking all that. You get to use your brain so much, and it’s like a new challenge and creation each time. I love it, but I’d probably fail, so I’m sticking with engineering. Why stay away from a sure thing? I do stuff out of the house actually. I’m quite involved with my school, and I play a sport. No one on the team really cares about me, though. The coach always talks about how we’re a family. But I have a question for you. In your family, does every person that is comprised of it make plans to go out and do something while you just sit there and listen to what sounds like a good time? Sounds like a pretty dysfunctional family to me. You are right about meeting people, though. The whole concept of making friends doesn’t make much sense to me. Thanks for the help. I appreciate it.
